The central focus is a green lighter and an orange/white branded lighter (possibly 'Lucky Strike' or similar tobacco branding) standing upright, with other lighters (blue, black, gold) visible in the background and foreground. There is significant visual noise and text artifacts overlaying the image.

artifact_observations.location: Top left corner and overlaying the blue lighter on the left
artifact_observations.reasoning: Severe nonsensical text artifacts ('hallucinated text') are present in the upper left and over the blue object. The characters are malformed and illegible, a common AI generation failure mode.
The branding/logo on the orange lighter is distorted and blurry. While it mimics a logo, the edges bleed into the background color, lacking the sharp print quality of a real manufactured object.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the green lighter and contact points with the surface
artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottoms of the lighters do not sit firmly on the surface; there is slight melting/fusion where the plastic meets the ground plane, lacking distinct shadow boundaries.
